Comparison

Gamma vs Beautiful.ai

A side-by-side look at Gamma and Beautiful.ai, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose Gamma when your priority is: getting from raw content to a presentable, on-brand deck fastest. Choose Beautiful.ai when your priority is: enforcing consistent, professional design across a team's decks.

Gamma vs Beautiful.ai at a glance

CriteriaGammaBeautiful.ai
CategoryAI Presentation ToolsAI Presentation Tools
Best forGetting from raw content to a presentable, on-brand deck fastest.Enforcing consistent, professional design across a team's decks.
Pricing modelFreemiumSubscription
Free planYesNo
Free trialNot verifiedYes
API availableYesNo
Platforms
  • Web, iOS, Android
  • Web, iOS, Android
  • PowerPoint and PDF export
Key features
  • Generate a full deck from a prompt, outline, pasted text or uploaded document
  • card-based responsive format that adapts to any screen
  • AI editing of individual cards
  • built-in image generation and stock search
  • themes and brand kit with custom fonts and colours
  • publish as a website with a custom domain
  • Smart Slide templates that auto-adjust layout, spacing and alignment as content changes
  • DesignerBot generating a full deck from a prompt
  • brand kit enforcing fonts, colours and logos across a team
  • slide library for approved reusable slides
  • collaboration and commenting
  • presentation analytics
Advantages
  • Fastest path from content to a decent-looking deck of anything in this group
  • the card format producing deck, doc and web page from one artefact is genuinely clever and more useful than it first sounds
  • view analytics on shared links are valuable for sales
  • output looks good without design skill.
  • The smart-template constraint is the point - it genuinely prevents bad slides, which is more valuable in a large organisation than more freedom would be
  • brand kit enforcement is strong and practical
  • the slide library for approved content solves a real sales-enablement problem
  • output consistently looks professional.
Limitations
  • The card format is not real PowerPoint - export to PPTX loses fidelity and breaks complex layouts, which is a problem if your organisation requires PPTX deliverables
  • less precise layout control than PowerPoint or Figma
  • credit consumption on Plus is easy to exhaust
  • RTL and Arabic typography need testing
  • The same constraint frustrates anyone who wants a specific custom layout - you work within the templates or not at all
  • no free tier makes evaluation commitment-heavy
  • AI generation (DesignerBot) is weaker than Gamma's
  • PowerPoint export is functional but not perfect

Pricing notes

Gamma

Free $0 with 400 one-time AI credits on signup, unlimited basic decks, but a 'Made with Gamma' badge on shared content. Plus around $10/mo ($8 annually) with 400 credits/month, badge removal and unlimited AI edits. Pro around $20/mo ($15 annually) with unlimited AI credits, advanced image models, custom fonts, detailed analytics and priority support. Business and Enterprise tiers with SSO, admin controls and shared brand kits. Annual billing roughly 20-25% cheaper.

Beautiful.ai

Pro around $12/mo billed annually (roughly $144/yr; higher billed monthly) for individuals. Team around $40-50/user/mo billed annually with brand kit, slide library, shared workspaces and admin controls. Enterprise custom, annual, with SSO and dedicated support. Beautiful.ai removed its free plan some years ago; a 14-day trial is the evaluation route.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: Gamma ↗ · Beautiful.ai ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between Gamma and Beautiful.ai?

Gamma: AI presentation and document tool that generates decks, documents and web pages from a prompt or pasted content, using a flexible card-based format rather than fixed slide dimensions - so output works equally as a… Beautiful.ai: Presentation tool built on 'smart slide' templates that automatically maintain professional design rules - as you add or remove content, the layout rebalances itself, so slides cannot easily be made ugly.

When should I choose Gamma over Beautiful.ai?

Gamma is listed as best for: getting from raw content to a presentable, on-brand deck fastest. Beautiful.ai is listed as best for: enforcing consistent, professional design across a team's decks.

Do Gamma and Beautiful.ai have a free plan?

Gamma: Yes. Beautiful.ai: No. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
